articles.title: Circle soars after securing U.S. trust bank approval in crypto expansion
articles.snippet: The approval adds to a growing list of crypto firms seeking federal banking licenses as the industry moves into the regulated financial system.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises to $64,000 as SK Hynix opens for trade after $26.5 billion IPO
articles.snippet: Spot bitcoin funds lost about $95 million on Thursday and ether funds roughly $52 million, ending the one bright spot in crypto's institutional flows even as prices rallied.

articles.title: MiCA licensing only the beginning as crypto custodians face scrutiny
articles.snippet: A MiCA license allows crypto firms to operate in the EU, but the ESMA’s review will test whether custodians can meet the required security and resilience standards.

articles.title: Zcash targets July 28 launch for Ironwood network upgrade
articles.snippet: Zcash’s next upgrade will replace the once-compromised Orchard pool and may offer clues about whether counterfeit tokens were created via a recent bug.

articles.title: DeFi may be ‘quietly re-rating’ given outperformance against Bitcoin: Bitwise
articles.snippet: “DeFi usually swings much harder than Bitcoin, so holding up this well is unusual,” says Bitwise, as DeFi tokens have outperformed Bitcoin.
